newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to auction 10.50 trln rbls bills, bonds.
newsitem.headline: Russia to auction 10.50 trln rbls bills, bonds.

text.p: The Finance Ministry will auction 7.50 trillion roubles of 266-day GKO discount Treasury bills and 3.00 trillion roubles of 18-month OFZ interest-bearing bonds on January 15, the Central Bank said on Wednesday.
Details of the bond issue (new tranche):
The series 24010 bonds closed on Monday at 100.19, yielding 36.47 percent. Tuesday was a holiday in Russia.
The series 22060 bills, maturing September 17, the nearest maturity date to the new bills, closed with a yield of 35.01.
The bonds will pay semi-annual interest of 187,884 roubles, equivalent to an annual rate of 37.68 percent, less accruals of 28,905.23 roubles, on June 18, 1997.

On January 15, the Finance Ministry will also repay about 6.08 trillion roubles of maturing six-month bills (series 22039) and pay about 582 billion roubles in interest on the two-year bond maturing July 1998 (series 24008).
